mapper.sql: id, label, path, icon, content, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume (id, label, path, icon, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{label}, #{path}, #{icon}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET label = #{label}, path = #{path}, icon = #{icon}, content = #{content}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
